features.description: Port arniwesth/motoko_agent PR #22 context_mode implementation to ailang-packages/packages/motoko-ext-context-mode/, bump 0.2.1 → 0.2.2, publish via cascade. Replaces the current stub with full provided_tools + on_tool_handle + on_describe_tools schemas + BashExec denial policy. Highest-leverage deliverable: lets Arni drop his local override.
acceptance_criteria: ailang-packages/packages/motoko-ext-context-mode/ updated with full implementation ported from arniwesth/motoko_agent PR #22 fix_context_mode_extension branch src/core/ext/context_mode/

register.ail has real provided_tools (CtxExecute, ctx_execute, CtxDoctor, CtxStats, ctx_index), real on_tool_handle routing through context-mode MCP bridge, on_describe_tools with concrete JSON schemas (required args: language, code, content, path, commands, queries per tool)
Policy logic added: deny direct BashExec calls when context-mode is loaded and the command targets context-mode
_smoke.ail exercises: register_with_config returns without panic, CtxDoctor/CtxStats dispatch, BashExec(context-mode ...) denied, on_describe_tools returns non-empty schemas
ailang.toml bumped to version 0.2.2
ailang check --package . passes
ailang publish --dry-run succeeds; ailang publish succeeds; registry index shows 0.2.2 as latest
Smoke-tested locally against motoko_agent via path-dep: verify_extensions boots cleanly with context_mode loaded
CHANGELOG entry in ailang-packages records the port + Arni's PR #22 attribution

features.description: cmd/ailang/init_motoko_extension.go enhanced to generate _smoke.ail template + per-tool on_describe_tools schema placeholders + README.md with path-dep workflow + publish checklist. Closes Q3 from discussion #23. Scaffold output goes from 3 files (manifest + register + types) to 5 files (+_smoke + README).
acceptance_criteria: ailang init motoko-extension --name X --tools "A,B" --effects "FS" generates 5 files: ailang.toml, register.ail, types.ail, _smoke.ail, README.md

_smoke.ail template covers register/dispatch/policy assertion patterns with `-- optional: drop if not applicable` markers (modeled on motoko_ext_compaction_ai 0.1.5 + arniwesth's smoke_context_mode_dispatch.ail shape)

Each --tools NAME arg produces an on_describe_tools block in register.ail with schema: '{"type":"object","required":[],"properties":{}}' placeholder + TODO comment referencing Anthropic typed tool use docs

README.md includes: path-dep dev workflow link, publish checklist (bump version → ailang publish --dry-run → ailang publish → consumer switches back to version pin), provider-safe tool naming reminder
Generated scaffold passes ailang check --package . with zero edits
Existing scaffold test (or new one in init_motoko_extension_test.go) verifies the 5-file structure
make test + make lint clean

features.description: cmd/registry-validator/main.go gains validateToolNames() that rejects publish when any advertised tool name contains '.' or non-[A-Za-z0-9_] characters (rejected by Anthropic Bedrock + Vertex AI). cmd/ailang/main.go gets --allow-dotted-tool-names migration flag mirroring --allow-unsafe-field-access pattern from M-WASM-AI-STEP-BYO-KEY. Closes Q4 from discussion #23.
acceptance_criteria: cmd/registry-validator/main.go has validateToolNames() that extracts tool names from provided_tools + on_describe_tools manifest entries, checks each against the [A-Za-z0-9_] charset, and rejects publish on violation
Structured error: {kind: 'tool_name_invalid', tool: 'ctx.execute', reason: 'contains dot', suggestion: 'use ctx_execute or CtxExecute'}

cmd/ailang/main.go has --allow-dotted-tool-names flag that downgrades the gate to WARN-level (mirrors --allow-unsafe-field-access pattern); plumbed through to registry-validator via env var or HTTP header

scripts/check_published_tool_names.sh (NEW) runs the new gate against all 13 currently-published sunholo/motoko_ext_* packages — must show zero false positives BEFORE this milestone is marked complete
make test includes a unit test for validateToolNames covering: rejects 'ctx.execute' (dot), rejects 'ctx-exec' (dash), accepts 'ctx_execute' (underscore), accepts 'CtxExecute' (mixed case)
make test + make lint clean
